Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a reduction in toll rates charged to motorcycles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to motorcycle toll rates; and amending RCW47.56.850.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.56.850 and 2008 c 122 s 7 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Unless these powers are otherwise delegated by the legislature,the transportation commission is the tolling authority for the state.The tolling authority shall: (a) Set toll rates, establish appropriate exemptions, if any, andmake adjustments as conditions warrant on eligible toll facilities; (b) Review toll collection policies, toll operations policies, andtoll revenue expenditures on the eligible toll facilities and reportannually on this review to the legislature. (2) The tolling authority, in determining toll rates, shallconsider the policy guidelines established in RCW 47.56.830. (3) Unless otherwise directed by the legislature, in setting andperiodically adjusting toll rates, the tolling authority must ensurethat toll rates will generate revenue sufficient to: p. 1 HB 2093 (a) Meet the operating costs of the eligible toll facilities,including necessary maintenance, preservation, administration, and tollenforcement by public law enforcement; (b) Meet obligations for the repayment of debt and interest on theeligible toll facilities, and any other associated financing costsincluding, but not limited to, required reserves, minimum debt coverageor other appropriate contingency funding, and insurance; and (c) Meet any other obligations of the tolling authority to provideits proportionate share of funding contributions for any projects oroperations of the eligible toll facilities. (4) The established toll rates may include variable pricing, andshould be set to optimize system performance, recognizing necessarytradeoffs to generate revenue for the purposes specified in subsection(3) of this section. Tolls may vary for type of vehicle, time of day,traffic conditions, or other factors designed to improve performance ofthe system. (5) Motorcycles, as defined in RCW 46.04.330, including motorcycleswith trailers in tow, must be charged a toll rate of no more than fiftypercent of the toll rate charged to passenger cars, as defined in RCW46.04.382.
